The epic Thaarak Hound cannot be summoned in public areas.

Summons an extremely tough CR35 Epic [[Thaarak Hound]].
* Over 7000 hitpoints.
* Primarily a spell caster, with high spell DCs and maximize and empower. Spells cast:
** [[Acid Blast (spell)|Acid Blast]]
** [[Cyclonic Blast]]
** [[Phantasmal Killer]] (Indirect through its Dance of Death, high enough DC to kill the odd epic monster)
* Very poor melee ability. The rare times it does attack, it deals around ~90 damage and attacks very slowly.
* Uses stealth. Can be hard to tell if he's following you unless you carefully manually click him or have a high Spot skill.
* Has a duration of 5 minutes, half that of a standard summon.

enchantments.tooltip: Heightened Awareness 4: This item helps you to quickly read situations with sharpness and clarity, allowing you to predict actions before they occur. You gain a +4 Insight bonus to AC.
Listen +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Listen skill.
Reflex Save +9: This item gives a +9 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.

Proof Against Disease +8: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +8 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).
